name: robots/umass-foundation-model__co-llm-agents
title: TDW-MAT transport_challenge_MA (ThreeDWorld multi-agent transport)
intro: TDW-MAT transport_challenge_MA (ThreeDWorld multi-agent transport), adapted from umass-foundation-model/co-llm-agents. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
